page_builder.block.heading: Heading
page_builder.check.alt: an image has no alternative text.
page_builder.check.embed_off: this feature is switched off, so readers will not see the embed.
page_builder.check.empty: this block is empty and will not be shown.
page_builder.check.h1: the page title is already the main heading; use section headings instead.
page_builder.check.heading_skip: this heading skips a level; screen reader users navigate by heading levels.
page_builder.check.table_header: tables are easier to understand with a header row.
page_builder.custom.conflict: This custom page changed since you opened the builder, so saving is refused. Copy anything you need, then
page_builder.custom.heading: Build the custom page {path}
page_builder.custom.no_drafts: Custom pages have no drafts: changes stay in this window until you save (Ctrl/Cmd + S).
page_builder.custom.published_hint: This page is published: saving shows your changes to every visitor at once.
page_builder.custom.title: Visual builder: {path}
page_builder.custom.unpublished_hint: This page is not published: only administrators can see it.
page_builder.editor.conflict: This page changed since you started, so your draft can no longer be saved or published. Copy anything you need, then
page_builder.editor.empty: Add a block from the list, or drop one here.
page_builder.editor.heading: Build “{title}”
page_builder.editor.insert_hint: New blocks go below the selected block, or at the end.
page_builder.editor.intro: Add blocks from the list or drag them onto the page. Everything is checked and cleaned by the wiki when you publish.
page_builder.editor.members_only: Builder pages are only shown to signed-in members unless an administrator publishes them as public.
page_builder.editor.paste_hint: Copy a block with its ⎘ button, on this or another page, then paste it here or press Ctrl/Cmd + V outside text fields.
page_builder.editor.public_hint: Visitors who are not signed in can see this page while public mode is on.
page_builder.editor.safety: No scripts, external images or arbitrary embeds: only safe blocks.
page_builder.editor.section_hint: Everyone who uses the builder can insert saved sections on any page.
page_builder.editor.shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + S saves your draft; Ctrl/Cmd + Z undoes a step outside text fields. Drafts are saved automatically.
page_builder.editor.stale_draft: Your draft was started on an older version of this page. Publishing it would overwrite newer changes, so it will be refused: discard the draft to start from the current page.
page_builder.editor.title: Visual builder: {title}
